profile.grammar_notes: Two copulas: ser (identity, origin, time, what something is) and estar (location, temporary state); hay for existence. Subject pronouns usually dropped; tú/usted politeness split (ustedes for all plural 'you' in Latin America, no vosotros). Negation with no before the verb; questions by intonation plus question words (qué, dónde, cuándo, cómo, quién, por qué). Core modals/needs: querer, poder, tener que, ir a + infinitive for near future. Gustar-type verbs with indirect object pronouns. Closed sets: subject pronouns, weekdays (lunes…domingo), months, articles, question words, possessives.
